notice: UPSTREAM.json records the imported baseline; the files below intentionally contain local integration changes, not pristine upstream hashes.

patches.name: Nocturne token-time native tree integration, 2026-10-10
patches.purpose: Optional synchronous element creation/reaction boundaries; stable parser form-owner/is metadata; declarative shadow roots and content-patching template destinations.
patches.default_behavior: With optional embedder callbacks unset, ordinary upstream template construction and inert-template behavior remain in place.

patches.name: Current URL Standard hosts and UTS #46 validity, 2026-10-26
patches.purpose: ASCII domains (including xn-- labels) are only lowercased, also after percent-decoding; host/hostname setters keep a host the override parse set even when the port after it fails, and keep the old host when none was set; an IPv4 number stays a number only if every code point is a digit, also past an overflowing prefix (ends-in-a-number checker); UTS #46 CheckBidi, CheckJoiners (virama context) and the leading-combining-mark rule.
patches.default_behavior: Non-ASCII domains still go through Lexbor's IDNA with the same flags; CheckBidi/CheckJoiners only apply when the caller passes them. A ZWNJ outside a virama is not yet checked against Joining_Type.
